title: An opening of the Add site form is recorded by its id (POST /api/sites/wizard), and the Create it led to carries the same id on site.create
steps: S1: POST /api/sites/wizard signed out, with no id, a bad id; then twice with the same id (once upper-cased).
S2: POST /api/sites with that wizardId; then another with a malformed one.
S3: The add-site client: wizardOpened, then createSite with the id; and a wizardOpened whose fetch throws.
S4: Mount the form twice in the same tab within milliseconds (measured on the stand 17/10), then after half an hour, then after a started Create.
expect: S1: 401, 400 INVALID_WIZARD_ID; one wizard.opened {wizard_id, where} for the id.
S2: site.create carries wizard_id; the malformed one creates the site and keeps no id.
S3: POST /api/sites/wizard {wizardId, where} then POST /api/sites with wizardId; a refusal or a thrown fetch says nothing.
S4: the two quick mounts share one id; half an hour later, or after a Create started, a new id; a tab with no or refusing storage still gets an id.
evidence: Plan tasks/todo-do-dung-that.md U4; council 17/10/2026: leaving the form before Create is lost unless recorded now; the stand acceptance 17/10 found one opening mounting the form twice, 12 ms apart, with two ids
fence: Never in the customer's way: the form does not wait, a malformed id is never a refusal

tests: POST /api/sites/wizard records one wizard.opened per id
the wizard tells tracy-web it opened
one opening of the wizard keeps one id across mounts
